The famous ship that sank in 1912 after hitting an iceberg is the **RMS Titanic**.

**Contextual Clarification:**
The provided text discusses **blockchains** and **cryptocurrencies**, which are modern digital technologies focused on secure, decentralized transaction records. This content is entirely unrelated to the historical maritime disaster of the RMS Titanic. The Titanic was a British passenger liner that tragically sank in the North Atlantic Ocean on its maiden voyage in April 1912, resulting in the loss of more than 1,500 lives. The juxtaposition of these two topics highlights the contrast between contemporary digital financial infrastructure and early 20th-century maritime history.
